text:
Maya: Draft of the launch post is up: https://drive.re/redwood/launch-draft — can folks skim the benchmark narrative and hero claim? Mostly worried about which latency stat to lead with (p50 vs p95).
Ethan: On it. Quick q — are the bench numbers Hosted-only or include Dedicated?
Maya: Hosted baseline in the main body, Dedicated numbers in the appendix. For headline options: 'sub-200ms p95' or 'median 30ms' — thoughts?
Priya: Legal flagged 'sub-200ms p95' — we need reproducible methodology inline if that's the claim. Also avoid vague words like "enterprise-grade" without an SLA.
Carlos: I can add a short methodology blurb + hardware table. Will paste the bench command too.
Carlos: bench command we ran: `python bench.py --model redwood-xl --seq 1024 --batch 1 --runs 100 --device a100`
Jesse: For GTM, lead with p50 for marketing-friendly story, include p95 in the benchmark appendix for platform customers.
Priya: That sounds fine. Legal will approve once the appendix lists hardware, dataset, request mix, and exact configs. @Carlos can you include dataset sample and seed?
Carlos: Yep — will add GPU type, kernel flags, batching policy, and a tiny dataset example. I'll link the harness: https://ci.re/redwood/bench-harness
Maya: CTA question — webinar registration should map to the launch flow and also tag for trial invites. @Marcom-bot can you wire inbound leads to webinar list + add tag `launch-early`?
Marcom-bot: Routing rule created: incoming form -> webinar-segment; tag attached: `launch-early`; followups set to 7 days. Confirm to enable.
Maya: Confirmed, enable it. Also need a quick approval on the hero quote (we pulled a line from CTO). @Ethan please OK copy?
Ethan: Tweaked the quote to avoid absolute claims, updated in doc. Approved :+1:
Priya: Legal approves the revised claim now that methodology details are included in the appendix :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks — final publish window scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll lock the doc in 30m and drop a readiness checklist. Any last blockers?
Jesse: All good from growth. I'll prep social snippets and the webinar landing page copy.
Carlos: Appendix updated with hardware table, exact commands, and raw logs link. Adding a one-paragraph note on variance.
Maya: Perfect. Locking doc now. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
